name: Divine Shield
description: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Paladin: reduces all damage you deal by 50% / increases the time between your attacks by 100%].  Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.
